services.name: Agricultural Subsidies
services.description: The Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) provides various government-subsidized agricultural programs to support local farmers and fisherfolk in Mapandan. These programs include subsidies for seeds, fertilizers, farm equipment, and technical assistance to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. Availability of subsidies depends on national and provincial funding allocations.
services.description_full: The Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) provides various government-subsidized agricultural programs to support local farmers and fisherfolk in Mapandan. These programs include subsidies for seeds, fertilizers, farm equipment, and technical assistance to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. Availability of subsidies depends on national and provincial funding allocations.
requirements: Farmer registration with the Municipal Agriculture Office
Barangay certification of residency and farming activity
Farm location and land area information
procedure: Register with the Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) as a farmer or fisherfolk.
Secure a barangay certification confirming your farming activity and residency.
Submit your registration and requirements to the MAO.
Wait for availability announcement of agricultural subsidies or programs.
Receive agricultural assistance or subsidies upon program approval.
services.hero_lede: Apply for government-subsidized agricultural programs in Mapandan. Learn about eligibility, requirements, and available assistance from the MAO.

services.name: AICS Assistance
services.description: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) is a government program that provides financial assistance to individuals and families facing emergencies such as medical crises, bereavement, or other unforeseen circumstances. In Mapandan, AICS assistance is administered by the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) in coordination with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
services.description_full: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) is a government program that provides financial assistance to individuals and families facing emergencies such as medical crises, bereavement, or other unforeseen circumstances. In Mapandan, AICS assistance is administered by the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) in coordination with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Barangay certification stating the resident’s crisis situation
Medical certificate (for medical-related assistance)
Death certificate (for burial assistance)
Valid government-issued ID
Case study or social worker assessment
procedure: Secure a barangay certification from your barangay captain or kagawad.
Gather all required documents (medical certificate, death certificate, etc.).
Visit the MSWDO office and submit your application with supporting documents.
Wait for the social worker’s assessment and case study.
Receive financial assistance upon approval of your application.
services.hero_lede: Apply for Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) in Mapandan. Learn about requirements, eligibility, and how to get help from the MSWDO.

services.name: Birth Certificate
services.description: A birth certificate is a vital record that serves as proof of identity, age, and Filipino citizenship. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered birth certificates. This document is required for school enrollment, passport application, employment, and other legal purposes.
services.description_full: A birth certificate is a vital record that serves as proof of identity, age, and Filipino citizenship. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered birth certificates. This document is required for school enrollment, passport application, employment, and other legal purposes.
services.fee: As scheduled by the MCR (varies by copy type)
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Valid government-issued ID of the requesting party
PSA copy of the birth certificate (if available, for verification)
Barangay certification of residency (for the person named on the certificate)
Affidavit of two disinterested persons (required for delayed registration only)
procedure: Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and present valid identification.
Fill out the request form and provide the necessary supporting documents.
Pay the certification fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Receive the certified birth certificate upon release.
services.hero_lede: Request a certified copy of your birth certificate from the Municipal Civil Registrar of Mapandan.

services.name: Building Permit
services.description: A building permit is a legal requirement under the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) for any construction, renovation, alteration, or demolition of a building or structure. The Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) of Mapandan reviews and issues building permits after ensuring compliance with safety standards, zoning, and structural requirements.
services.description_full: A building permit is a legal requirement under the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) for any construction, renovation, alteration, or demolition of a building or structure. The Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) of Mapandan reviews and issues building permits after ensuring compliance with safety standards, zoning, and structural requirements.
services.fee: Based on project cost (schedule per National Building Code)
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Engineering Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Approved zoning clearance from the MPDC
Architectural plans (signed and sealed by a licensed architect)
Structural plans (signed and sealed by a licensed civil/structural engineer)
Bill of materials and cost estimate
Certificate of land title or ownership documents
Tax clearance / latest real property tax payment
procedure: Obtain a zoning clearance from the MPDC / Zoning Office.
Prepare architectural and structural plans signed by licensed professionals.
Submit all documents to the Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) for review.
Pay the building permit fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Receive the approved building permit after technical evaluation.
services.hero_lede: Secure a building permit before commencing any construction or renovation in the Municipality of Mapandan.

services.name: New Business Permit
services.description: A business permit is required for all individuals or entities intending to operate a commercial business within the Municipality of Mapandan. This permit is issued after compliance with documentary and safety requirements and upon payment of applicable fees.
services.description_full: A business permit is required for all individuals or entities intending to operate a commercial business within the Municipality of Mapandan. This permit is issued after compliance with documentary and safety requirements and upon payment of applicable fees.
services.processing_time: ~1 hour (10 min encoding + 44 min endorsement + 10 min pay & claim)
services.fee: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200)
requirements: Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office)
DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application)
BIR COR, if available (from RDO Calasiao)
Barangay Clearance (System Integrated)
procedure: Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min).
BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System.

BPLO endorses applicant to various offices: Engineering (Occupancy Certificate), MPDC (Zoning Certificate), RHU (Health Certificate & Sanitary Permit), BFP (Fire Safety Inspection Certificate) (44 min).
Pay fees and charges at the Treasury Office.
Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of Business Permit.
Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office (10 min).
services.hero_lede: Apply for a new business permit at the BPLO in Mapandan. Includes endorsement to Engineering, MPDC, RHU, and BFP.

services.name: Business Permit Renewal
services.description: Businesses operating within Mapandan are required to renew their business permits annually. Renewal ensures that your business remains compliant with local regulations and avoids penalties for late filing.
services.description_full: Businesses operating within Mapandan are required to renew their business permits annually. Renewal ensures that your business remains compliant with local regulations and avoids penalties for late filing.
services.processing_time: ~1 hour (similar to new business permit process)
services.fee: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Tax (% of Gross Sales) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200)
requirements: Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office)
DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application)
BIR COR (from RDO Calasiao)
Barangay Clearance (System Integrated)
procedure: Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min).
BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System.
BPLO endorses applicant to Engineering, MPDC, RHU, and BFP for required certificates (44 min).
Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Fees include Mayor's Permit, Business Tax (% of Gross Sales), Plate & Sticker, Weights & Measure, Storage Fee, and Garbage Fee.
Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of renewed Business Permit.
Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office.
services.hero_lede: Renew your business permit at the BPLO in Mapandan. Annual renewal required to maintain compliance.

services.name: Cedula / Community Tax Certificate
services.description: The Community Tax Certificate, commonly known as a cedula, is a requirement for residents of Mapandan engaged in certain transactions with government agencies. It serves as proof of community tax payment and is required for various legal, business, and personal transactions. The cedula is issued under the provisions of the Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160).
services.description_full: The Community Tax Certificate, commonly known as a cedula, is a requirement for residents of Mapandan engaged in certain transactions with government agencies. It serves as proof of community tax payment and is required for various legal, business, and personal transactions. The cedula is issued under the provisions of the Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160).
services.fee: ₱500 (basic community tax) + ₱1 per ₱1,000 of income (if applicable)
requirements: Valid government-issued ID
Payment of community tax
procedure: Present your valid ID at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Pay the basic community tax of ₱500.
If applicable, pay an additional ₱1 per ₱1,000 of gross income earned during the preceding year.
Receive your community tax certificate (cedula).
services.hero_lede: Obtain your community tax certificate (cedula) in Mapandan. Learn about fees, requirements, and where to apply.

services.name: Death Certificate
services.description: A death certificate is an official document that records the death of an individual. It is required for settlement of estates, insurance claims, pension benefits, and other legal matters. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered death certificates.
services.description_full: A death certificate is an official document that records the death of an individual. It is required for settlement of estates, insurance claims, pension benefits, and other legal matters. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered death certificates.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Medical certificate or certificate of cause of death
Valid government-issued ID of the requesting party
Barangay certification (for the requesting party’s relationship to the deceased)
procedure: Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and present valid identification.
Fill out the request form and provide supporting documents.
Pay the certification fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Receive the certified death certificate upon release.
services.hero_lede: Request a certified copy of a death certificate from the Municipal Civil Registrar of Mapandan.

services.name: Health Consultation
services.description: The Municipal Health Office (MHO) / Rural Health Unit (RHU) provides free health consultation services to all residents of Mapandan. This includes general medical consultations, health advice, and referrals to higher-level health facilities when necessary. Walk-in patients are served on a first-come, first-served basis.
services.description_full: The Municipal Health Office (MHO) / Rural Health Unit (RHU) provides free health consultation services to all residents of Mapandan. This includes general medical consultations, health advice, and referrals to higher-level health facilities when necessary. Walk-in patients are served on a first-come, first-served basis.
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
procedure: Register in Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife registers new patients and encodes data.
Classify patient: PhilHealth member (attach ID number) or non-PhilHealth member.
Record consultation date, vital signs, and chief complaint.
Occupy seats in waiting area and wait for name to be called.
MHO check-up, assess, and treat the patient. Schedule follow-up check-up.
Give available medicines to patient and encode.
services.hero_lede: Free health consultation at the Mapandan RHU. Walk-in service for all residents. 25 minutes per client.

services.name: Transfer of Land Ownership
services.description: Transfer of land ownership is the legal process of transferring property rights from one owner to another. This process involves coordination between the Municipal Assessor’s Office (MASSO) and the Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) to update property records and ensure proper tax assessment. The transfer may be due to sale, donation, inheritance, or other legal means.
services.description_full: Transfer of land ownership is the legal process of transferring property rights from one owner to another. This process involves coordination between the Municipal Assessor’s Office (MASSO) and the Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) to update property records and ensure proper tax assessment. The transfer may be due to sale, donation, inheritance, or other legal means.
services.office: Municipal Assessor’s Office (MASSO) + Municipal Treasury Office (MTO)
services.fee: Varies (assessor’s fee based on property value)
requirements: Deed of sale or deed of donation (depending on transfer type)
Tax clearance from the Municipal Treasurer’s Office
Valid government-issued ID of the new owner
Original tax declaration
Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) certificate of registration
procedure: Secure a tax clearance from the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Obtain the BIR certificate of registration for the transfer.
Submit all required documents to the Municipal Assessor’s Office (MASSO).
Pay the assessor’s fee based on the property value.
Wait for processing and verification of documents.
Receive the updated tax declaration under the new owner’s name.
services.hero_lede: Transfer land ownership in Mapandan. Learn about the requirements, procedures, and fees for property transfer at the Assessor's Office.

services.name: Marriage License
services.description: A marriage license is a legal requirement before a marriage can be solemnized in the Philippines. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan processes marriage license applications, which include a required publication period. The license is valid for 120 days from the date of issuance.
services.description_full: A marriage license is a legal requirement before a marriage can be solemnized in the Philippines. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan processes marriage license applications, which include a required publication period. The license is valid for 120 days from the date of issuance.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Birth certificates (PSA-authenticated) of both contracting parties
Valid government-issued IDs of both parties
Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR) for both parties
Parental consent or advice (if either party is under 25 years old)
Certificate of Marriage Counseling (from a government-accredited counselor)
Community Tax Certificate (cedula) for both parties
Two (2) ID photos of each party
procedure: Both parties appear at the MCR and submit all required documents.
Fill out the marriage license application form.
Pay the applicable fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Wait for the 10-day publication period.
After publication, claim the marriage license from the MCR.
services.hero_lede: Apply for a marriage license at the Municipal Civil Registrar of Mapandan, Pangasinan.

services.name: Name Correction (RA 9048)
services.description: Republic Act No. 9048 authorizes the city or municipal civil registrar to correct clerical or typographical errors in civil registry entries without the need for a judicial order. This covers corrections in first names, nicknames, or minor spelling errors. This process does not apply to changes in gender, date of birth, or other substantive entries.
services.description_full: Republic Act No. 9048 authorizes the city or municipal civil registrar to correct clerical or typographical errors in civil registry entries without the need for a judicial order. This covers corrections in first names, nicknames, or minor spelling errors. This process does not apply to changes in gender, date of birth, or other substantive entries.
services.fee: As scheduled by the MCR (includes publication cost)
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: PSA-authenticated birth certificate (original and photocopy)
Valid government-issued ID of the petitioner
Supporting documents that prove the correct name (e.g., school records, baptismal certificate, IDs)
Notarized affidavit of the petitioner explaining the error
Publication of the correction in a local newspaper (for the required period)
procedure: Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and submit all required documents.
File the petition for correction of clerical error.
Pay the required fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Wait for the publication period to be completed.
After publication and verification, claim the corrected birth certificate from the MCR.
services.hero_lede: Correct clerical or typographical errors in your birth certificate under Republic Act No. 9048.

services.name: Occupancy Permit
services.description: An occupancy permit certifies that a building or structure has been completed and inspected in accordance with the approved plans and the National Building Code. It is required before any building may be legally occupied or used.
services.description_full: An occupancy permit certifies that a building or structure has been completed and inspected in accordance with the approved plans and the National Building Code. It is required before any building may be legally occupied or used.
services.where_to_apply: Municipal Engineering Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Approved building permit
As-built plans (reflecting the actual construction)
Inspection report from the Municipal Engineering Office
Fire safety inspection certificate from the Bureau of Fire Protection
procedure: Request a final inspection from the Municipal Engineering Office.
Submit the as-built plans and inspection report.
Obtain a fire safety inspection certificate from the BFP.
Submit all documents to the MEO for review.
Receive the occupancy permit upon approval.
services.hero_lede: Obtain an occupancy permit to legally occupy a newly constructed or renovated building in Mapandan.

services.name: Real Property Tax Payment
services.description: Real property tax (RPT) is an annual tax on the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements owned by individuals or entities within the Municipality of Mapandan. Payment of RPT is required under the Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160) and Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020. The tax is used to fund local services, infrastructure, and public welfare programs.
services.description_full: Real property tax (RPT) is an annual tax on the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements owned by individuals or entities within the Municipality of Mapandan. Payment of RPT is required under the Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160) and Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020. The tax is used to fund local services, infrastructure, and public welfare programs.
services.fee: Based on assessed value (1% annual for basic, additional for SEF)
services.source: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter / Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020
requirements: Tax declaration from the Municipal Assessor’s Office
Previous year’s official receipt
Valid government-issued ID
procedure: Present your tax declaration and previous year’s official receipt at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Verify the current assessed value of your property with the assessor.
Pay the corresponding real property tax at the treasury counter.
Receive your official receipt as proof of payment.
services.hero_lede: Pay your real property tax obligations in Mapandan. Learn about assessment rates, fees, and step-by-step payment procedures.

services.name: Sanitary Permit
services.description: A sanitary permit is required for all businesses that handle food, beverages, or other consumable products to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards. The permit is issued by the Municipal Health Office (MHO) after an inspection of the business premises to verify that health and safety regulations are met.
services.description_full: A sanitary permit is required for all businesses that handle food, beverages, or other consumable products to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards. The permit is issued by the Municipal Health Office (MHO) after an inspection of the business premises to verify that health and safety regulations are met.
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
Laboratory Tests: CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, sputum exam, Hepatitis B (from RHU Primary Laboratory)
Chest X-Ray, PA (from government or private diagnostic facility)
procedure: Present official receipt from the Treasury Office.
Laboratory examination of urine, feces, sputum is conducted by Medical Technologist (30 min).
Refer to other laboratories for X-ray if needed (2 min).
Refer result to MHO for interpretation (10 min).
MHO does physical examination and interprets result (5 min).
MHO prescribes medicines if needed (2 min).
MHO signs the certification (2 min).
List down certificate number on logbook and release certification (2 min).
services.hero_lede: Get a sanitary permit, health certificate, or medical certificate at the Mapandan RHU. 53 minutes processing time.

services.name: Senior Citizen / PWD ID
services.description: The Senior Citizen ID and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID are government-issued identification cards that provide holders with benefits and privileges under the law. Senior Citizens (60 years old and above) and PWDs are entitled to discounts, tax exemptions, and other benefits as mandated by RA 9994 (Senior Citizens Act) and RA 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons). The IDs are processed through the MSWDO and MCR in coordination with the national implementing agencies.
services.description_full: The Senior Citizen ID and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID are government-issued identification cards that provide holders with benefits and privileges under the law. Senior Citizens (60 years old and above) and PWDs are entitled to discounts, tax exemptions, and other benefits as mandated by RA 9994 (Senior Citizens Act) and RA 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons). The IDs are processed through the MSWDO and MCR in coordination with the national implementing agencies.
requirements: Birth certificate or PSA-issued document as proof of age (for Senior Citizens)
Barangay certification of residency
Two (2) pieces of 2x2 ID photos
Medical certificate (for PWD applicants, indicating the nature of disability)
procedure: Secure a barangay certification of residency from your barangay office.
For PWD applicants, obtain a medical certificate indicating the nature and severity of the disability.
Submit all required documents to the MSWDO or MCR office.
Wait for verification and processing of your application.
Receive your Senior Citizen or PWD ID upon approval.
services.hero_lede: Apply for a Senior Citizen or Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID in Mapandan. Learn about requirements, eligibility, and where to apply.

services.name: Special Event Permit
services.description: A special event permit is required for individuals or organizations planning to hold public events within Mapandan. This includes festivals, concerts, trade fairs, sports tournaments, and other gatherings that may affect public roads, spaces, or safety.
services.description_full: A special event permit is required for individuals or organizations planning to hold public events within Mapandan. This includes festivals, concerts, trade fairs, sports tournaments, and other gatherings that may affect public roads, spaces, or safety.
services.fee: Varies by event type and scale
requirements: Event proposal with detailed description, expected attendance, and schedule
Sketch or map of the event venue
Safety and security plan
Event insurance (if applicable, depending on event type and size)
Barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will be held
procedure: Secure a barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will take place.
Prepare the event proposal, venue sketch, and safety plan.
Submit all requirements to the Municipal Treasurer’s Office (MTO) and/or Mayor’s Office.
Wait for review and approval; pay any required fees.
Receive the approved special event permit.
services.hero_lede: Obtain a permit for special events such as festivals, concerts, fairs, and other public gatherings in Mapandan.

services.name: Tax Declaration Copy
services.description: A tax declaration is an official document that shows the assessed value of your real property for taxation purposes. Property owners may request certified copies of their tax declaration for various legal, financial, and administrative transactions, including property sales, loans, and insurance applications.
services.description_full: A tax declaration is an official document that shows the assessed value of your real property for taxation purposes. Property owners may request certified copies of their tax declaration for various legal, financial, and administrative transactions, including property sales, loans, and insurance applications.
requirements: Valid government-issued ID
Written request stating the purpose of the request
Payment of ₱50 per copy
procedure: Submit a written request to the Municipal Assessor’s Office (MASSO) stating the purpose of your request.
Present your valid government-issued ID for verification.
Pay ₱50 per copy at the designated payment counter.
Receive your certified tax declaration copy after processing.
services.hero_lede: Request a copy of your tax declaration from the Municipal Assessor's Office in Mapandan. Learn about fees, requirements, and processing time.

services.name: Zoning Clearance
services.description: A zoning clearance certifies that the intended use or construction on a property complies with the municipality’s land use plan and zoning regulations. It is a prerequisite for obtaining a building permit or for any change in land use classification.
services.description_full: A zoning clearance certifies that the intended use or construction on a property complies with the municipality’s land use plan and zoning regulations. It is a prerequisite for obtaining a building permit or for any change in land use classification.
services.office: Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) / Zoning Office
services.where_to_apply: MPDC / Zoning Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Certificate of land title or ownership documents (e.g., Tax Declaration, Deed of Sale)
Site development plan or proposed layout
Sketch of property location (showing the lot in relation to nearby streets/landmarks)
procedure: Visit the Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) or Zoning Office.
Submit the required documents along with the zoning clearance application form.
Pay the applicable fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office.
Receive the zoning clearance after verification of land use compliance.
services.hero_lede: Obtain a zoning clearance before constructing, renovating, or changing the use of a property in Mapandan.

services.name: Certificate of Indigency
services.description: A Certificate of Indigency is issued to indigent families certified by the Barangay Captain. It is used to avail of hospital discounts, legal assistance from PAO, scholarship assistance, and other social services.
services.description_full: The Certificate of Indigency is issued by the MSWDO to indigent families certified by the Barangay Captain. This document is required to avail of various services including hospital discounts, legal assistance from the Public Attorney's Office (PAO), scholarship assistance for college education, and other social welfare programs. The MSWDO conducts an interview and assessment to verify the client's eligibility before issuing the certificate.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Barangay Certificate of Indigency
Medical Certificate (if hospitalized)
Police report / Police blotter / RTC/MTC report (if applicable)
Report Card Form 138 / Recommendation (if for students)
Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR)
procedure: Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you and conduct an initial interview.
Submit your Barangay Certificate of Indigency and other supporting documents.
Staff will conduct an interview and assess your eligibility for assistance.
Receive your Certificate of Indigency upon approval.
services.hero_lede: Get a Certificate of Indigency from the MSWDO for hospital discounts, legal aid, scholarships, and other social services.

services.name: Solo Parent ID
services.description: The Solo Parent ID is issued to solo parents as mandated by RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000). The ID provides benefits including flexible work arrangements, educational assistance, and health care privileges.
services.description_full: The Solo Parent ID is issued by the MSWDO to qualifying solo parents as mandated by RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000). Holders are entitled to benefits including flexible work arrangements, educational assistance for children, and health care privileges. The MSWDO assesses eligibility using the solo parent intake form. Processing includes a 6-month assessment period before the ID is issued.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Barangay Certificate
Birth Certificate of minor child/children under custody
1x1 picture
procedure: Register at the MSWDO and submit your requirements.
Staff will check and verify your submitted documents.
Submit your requirements and undergo assessment using the solo parent intake form.
After 6 months of assessment, the Solo Parent ID is recorded in the logbook and issued.
services.hero_lede: Apply for a Solo Parent ID in Mapandan. Learn about eligibility, requirements, and the assessment process at the MSWDO.

services.name: Scholarship Certification
services.description: The MSWDO issues certifications for students who wish to avail of scholarship programs, tuition fee discounts, or educational assistance from schools, universities, and government agencies.
services.description_full: The MSWDO issues certifications for students who wish to avail of scholarship programs, tuition fee discounts, or educational assistance from schools, universities, and government agencies. The certification verifies the student's residency and financial status, which is required by most scholarship-granting institutions.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Request letter stating the purpose
Valid ID (school ID or government-issued)
procedure: Request the list of requirements from MSWDO staff.
Staff will explain the requirements and process.
MSWDO prepares the certification for educational assistance, school fees discount, or scholarship.
Receive the issued certification.
services.hero_lede: Get a Scholarship Certification from the MSWDO for educational assistance and tuition fee discounts.

services.name: PWD Assistive Devices
services.description: The MSWDO provides assistive devices such as crutches, wheelchairs, prosthesis, and other gadgets to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) to help them integrate into the mainstream of community life.
services.description_full: The MSWDO provides assistive devices such as crutches, wheelchairs, prosthesis, and other gadgets to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) to help them integrate into the mainstream of community life. The service covers orthopedically handicapped, visually impaired, and immobile individuals aged 0–59 years old. The MSWDO coordinates with PSWDO and DSWD Field Office I for funding and procurement of devices.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
services.processing_time: Varies (1 day to several weeks depending on device availability)
requirements: Barangay Certificate of Indigency
Medical Certificate with doctor's recommendation for assistive device
Whole body picture
procedure: Apply at the MSWDO. A family member may represent the client.
Staff will interview and gather relevant information from the client or family member.
Submit Barangay Certificate, Medical Certificate, and whole body picture.
MSWDO conducts follow-up, home visit, and assesses eligibility and device needs.
MSWDO prepares and submits documents to PSWDO/DSWD FO1 for funding and purchase.
Receive the assistive device (crutches, wheelchair, prosthesis, etc.) upon availability.
services.hero_lede: Request assistive devices for PWDs from the MSWDO in Mapandan. Crutches, wheelchairs, and other devices available.

services.name: OSCA Death Aid Benefits
services.description: The OSCA Death Aid Benefits provide financial assistance to families of deceased Senior Citizens. The benefit is processed through the MSWDO upon submission of required documents.
services.description_full: The OSCA Death Aid Benefits provide financial assistance to families of deceased Senior Citizens. The benefit is processed through the MSWDO upon submission of the deceased's original death certificate, two photocopies of the OSCA ID, and surrender of the OSCA ID. The MSWDO prepares the application and submits reports to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Certificate of Indigency
Death Certificate (original copy)
OSCA ID (original + two photocopies)
procedure: Register at the MSWDO. Staff will conduct intake interview and assess eligibility.
Submit the deceased's original Death Certificate, two photocopies of OSCA ID, and surrender the OSCA ID.
MSWDO prepares the Application Form and Certificate of Eligibility.
MSWDO submits report with attached documents to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation.
Follow up with the MSWDO for the status of financial assistance.
Receive the OSCA financial assistance at the Municipal Treasury Office.
services.hero_lede: Claim OSCA Death Aid Benefits for deceased senior citizens. Learn about requirements and the claims process at the MSWDO.

services.name: Social Case Study Report
services.description: A Social Case Study Report is issued to clients who need to avail of assistance from PCSO, other government hospitals, institutions, NGOs, DSWD, and various foundations. The report is prepared by MSWDO social workers after a thorough assessment.
services.description_full: A Social Case Study Report is issued to clients who need to avail of assistance from PCSO, other government hospitals, institutions, NGOs, DSWD, and various foundations. The report is prepared by MSWDO social workers after a thorough assessment that includes an initial interview, home visit, and evaluation of the client's situation. The report serves as a supporting document for various forms of assistance.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
services.processing_time: 30 minutes to 1 hour (may require home visit)
requirements: Certificate of Indigency from Barangay Captain
Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract / Medico-Legal report
Police report / Police blotter (if applicable)
Whole body picture
Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR)
Psychiatric Evaluation Report (as needed)
procedure: Apply at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you for initial interview.
Discuss your problem and provide relevant information. Staff conducts initial interview and gathers data.
Staff may conduct a home visit or follow-up, especially for CICL cases.
Submit Barangay Certificate of Indigency and other required documents.
MSWDO prepares and computerizes the Social Case Study Report.
Receive your copy of the Social Case Study Report upon approval.
services.hero_lede: Get a Social Case Study Report from the MSWDO for PCSO, hospital, and foundation assistance applications.

services.name: Pre-Marriage Counseling
services.description: The MSWDO provides pre-marriage counseling to would-be couples as required before obtaining a marriage license. The counseling covers family planning, rights and responsibilities of marriage, and strengthening family solidarity.
services.description_full: The MSWDO provides pre-marriage counseling to would-be couples as required before obtaining a marriage license. The counseling covers family planning, rights and responsibilities of marriage, and strengthening family solidarity. The service is mandated by law and the certificate issued is a prerequisite for marriage license application. Would-be couples, couples with marital problems, couples of reproductive age, and solo parents may avail of this service.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Personal Data Form
Marriage Counselling Services Form
procedure: Apply at the MSWDO. Staff will refer you to the Population Office.
Fill out the Personal Data Form and Marriage Counselling Services Form.
Attend the Marriage Counseling Seminar conducted by MSWDO staff.
After the seminar, the Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate is signed by the counselor.
Receive the duly signed Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate.
services.hero_lede: Complete your pre-marriage counseling requirement at the MSWDO in Mapandan. Required before applying for a marriage license.

services.name: Children in Difficult Circumstances (CICL)
services.description: The MSWDO provides care and protection services for Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) and children under difficult circumstances, including abandoned, neglected, physically and sexually abused, and emotionally abused children.
services.description_full: The MSWDO provides care and protection services for Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) and children under difficult circumstances. Services include surveillance, rescue and recovery, counselling, referral to PNP, temporary shelter, and custody care. The MSWDO coordinates with the PNP, hospitals, and Prosecutor's Office as necessary.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Birth Certificate (PSA)
Medical Certificate / Medico-legal report
Police Blotter Report
procedure: Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer the client for intake.
Discuss the problem and provide relevant information. Staff interviews and gathers data.
Staff refers the client to other agencies (PNP, Hospital, Prosecutor's Office) if necessary.
Staff prepares draft of Social Case Study Report and follows up with home visits and counseling.
Present results. MSWDO prepares and submits Social Case Study Report.
services.hero_lede: MSWDO protection services for children in difficult circumstances in Mapandan. Counselling, shelter, and referral available.

services.name: Women's Welfare (WSDW)
services.description: The MSWDO promotes the welfare of socially disadvantaged women, including battered and maltreated women and rape victims. Services include rescue and recovery, counselling, referral to other agencies, and temporary shelter and custody care.
services.description_full: The MSWDO promotes the welfare of socially disadvantaged women, including battered and maltreated women and rape victims. Services include rescue and recovery, counselling, referral to other agencies, and temporary shelter and custody care. The MSWDO coordinates with PNP, hospitals, and the Prosecutor's Office for cases requiring legal action.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Police Blotter Report
Medical Certificate / Medico-legal report
Barangay blotter report
procedure: Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer the client for intake.
Discuss the problem and provide relevant information. Staff interviews, gathers data, and counsels.
Staff refers the client to PNP, Hospital, Prosecutor's Office, or other agencies if necessary.
Follow up with home visits, counseling, and other services as needed.
services.hero_lede: MSWDO welfare services for socially disadvantaged women in Mapandan. Counselling, shelter, and referral available.

services.name: Disaster Relief Assistance
services.description: The MSWDO provides disaster relief assistance and rehabilitation services to families affected by floods, typhoons, fires, and other calamities. The service includes distribution of relief goods and financial assistance for housing repair.
services.description_full: The MSWDO provides disaster relief assistance and rehabilitation services to families affected by floods, typhoons, fires, and other calamities. The service includes verification of affected families, distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC, and financial assistance (ESA) for families whose houses are totally destroyed. The MSWDO coordinates with the LGU, PSWDO, and DSWD Field Office I.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
services.processing_time: Varies (1 day for relief goods, 1–3 weeks for financial assistance)
requirements: Master list of affected families (from Barangay Captain)
Barangay certificate
Certificate of Indigency
procedure: Report to the Barangay Captain the extent of damage. The Captain validates and forwards the list to MSWDO.
MSWDO attends MDDC meeting conducted by the Local Chief Executive.
MSWDO receives list of affected families and endorses to concerned social worker.
Verification and inspection team (with Engineering, PNP, DSWD) assesses the damage.
MSWDO requests and lobbies for allocation of relief goods from LGU, PSWDO, DSWD FO1.
Distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC.
For totally destroyed houses, MSWDO prepares project proposal for ESA funding.
Financial assistance (ESA) is distributed to qualified beneficiaries.
MSWDO monitors and evaluates project implementation for house repair/reconstruction.
services.hero_lede: Disaster relief assistance for families affected by calamities in Mapandan. Relief goods and housing repair assistance available.

services.name: Special Social Services
services.description: The MSWDO provides special social services for mentally challenged clients and other individuals requiring specialized assistance. Services include counselling, referral to hospitals, and coordination for PhilHealth Point of Care benefits.
services.description_full: The MSWDO provides special social services for mentally challenged clients and other individuals requiring specialized assistance. Services include counselling, referral to other agencies and hospitals, preparation of Social Case Study Reports, and coordination for PhilHealth Point of Care benefits. The MSWDO assesses client eligibility and prepares referral letters to district hospitals and medical centers.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
requirements: Certificate of Indigency from Barangay Captain
Medical Certificate (if necessary)
Birth Certificate
Marriage Certificate (if married)
procedure: Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer the client for intake.
Discuss the problem and provide relevant information. Staff interviews and assesses the client.
Submit Certificate of Indigency, Medical Certificate, Birth Certificate, and whole body picture.
MSWDO prepares referral letter or Social Case Study Report (SCSR).
Receive the Social Case Study Report or Referral Letter.
Proceed to other concerned agencies as necessary (District Hospital, PRU Hospital, Region 1 Medical Center).
MSWDO coordinates for PhilHealth Point of Care eligibility assessment.
Receive Certificate of Indigency for PhilHealth benefits.
services.hero_lede: Special social services for mentally challenged individuals in Mapandan. Counselling, referral, and PhilHealth coordination.

services.name: Day Care Program
services.description: The MSWDO operates a Day Care Service Program for pre-schoolers in the barangay. The program provides early childhood education through regular sessions conducted by Child Development Workers at Day Care Centers.
services.description_full: The MSWDO operates a Day Care Service Program for pre-schoolers in the barangay. The program provides early childhood education through regular sessions conducted by Child Development Workers at Day Care Centers. Parents register their children and attend regular sessions and parents' meetings. The program also includes annual events such as Nutrition Month Celebration, Children's Congress, and Family Day.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)
services.where_to_apply: Day Care Center in your barangay
requirements: Child must be of pre-school age
Registration at the Day Care Center
procedure: Register your child at the Day Care Center in your barangay.
Fill out the registration forms. Staff will assess the child's birth certificate.
Send or accompany your child to the Day Care Center for regular sessions (2–3 hours).
Attend Day Care parents' meetings as scheduled.
services.hero_lede: Enroll your pre-schooler in the Mapandan Day Care Program. Free early childhood education at barangay Day Care Centers.

services.name: Pre-Natal Consultation
services.description: The RHU provides pre-natal consultation services for antenatal women. The service includes registration, physical examination, laboratory tests, health teaching, and classification of pregnancy risk level.
services.description_full: The RHU provides pre-natal consultation services for antenatal women. The service includes registration in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), OB history, vital signs, Leopold's maneuver, fetal heartbeat assessment, and fundic height measurement. Routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg, RPR) are requested. The MHO conducts complete physical examination, interprets laboratory results, and provides health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. High-risk patients are referred to higher-level facilities.
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
Medical Records, Laboratory Results, Prescription for Medicines (from previous physician, if any)
procedure: Register in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife encodes OB history, vital signs, and performs Leopold's maneuver.
Request for routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg Screening, RPR test).
MHO performs complete physical examination and interprets laboratory results.
If high-risk, patient is referred to a higher level of facility.
Health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization.
services.hero_lede: Free pre-natal consultation for antenatal women at the Mapandan Rural Health Unit. Lab tests and health teaching included.

services.name: Family Planning
services.description: The RHU provides family planning services to couples, including counselling on different methods, assessment of suitability, and provision of oral pills and DMPA injectables.
services.description_full: The RHU provides family planning services to couples, including counselling on different family planning methods along with their advantages and disadvantages. The MHO assesses whether the chosen method is suitable and appropriate for the mother. Available methods include oral pills and DMPA injectables. Data encoding, obstetric history, and vital signs are recorded during the consultation.
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
procedure: Register in the log book. Midwife encodes data, obstetric history, and vital signs.
Receive counselling on different family planning methods, including advantages and disadvantages.
Select the preferred family planning method.
MHO assesses whether the method is suitable and appropriate.
Provision of family planning method (oral pills or DMPA injectable).
services.hero_lede: Free family planning services at the Mapandan RHU. Counselling and provision of oral pills and injectables for couples.

services.name: TB DOTS Treatment
services.description: The RHU provides Directly Observed Treatment Short Course (TB DOTS) for patients with tuberculosis. The service includes sputum examination, GeneXpert testing, physical examination, and provision of anti-TB drugs.
services.description_full: The RHU provides Directly Observed Treatment Short Course (TB DOTS) for patients with tuberculosis. The service includes registration, sputum examination, GeneXpert/TBDC testing, physical examination, and provision of anti-TB drugs with proper intake instructions. The MHO maintains patient confidentiality and monitors treatment compliance.
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
Medical Records, Prescription of Medicines (from previous physician, if any)
Chest X-Ray PA Result (from government or private diagnostic facility)
procedure: Register in the log book. Midwife encodes data, vital signs, and asks about symptoms and duration.
Submit sputum for examination.
Sputum examination is conducted. Patient is referred to GeneXpert/TBDC for further testing.
Consent is secured and confidentiality is maintained.
MHO conducts physical examination of patient.
Anti-TB drugs are given with record and patient is advised on proper intake.
services.hero_lede: Free TB DOTS treatment at the Mapandan RHU. Sputum testing, GeneXpert, and anti-TB medication available.

services.name: Laboratory Examination
services.description: The RHU primary laboratory provides various diagnostic tests including ABO/RH typing, pregnancy test, CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, Hepatitis B screening, and fasting blood sugar (FBS).
services.description_full: The RHU primary laboratory provides various diagnostic tests including ABO/RH typing, pregnancy test, CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, Hepatitis B screening, and fasting blood sugar (FBS). The MHO provides a laboratory request, and the Medical Technologist conducts the examination. Results are interpreted by the MHO who prescribes medications as needed.
services.processing_time: ~2 hours per client (varies by tests requested)
services.where_to_apply: Rural Health Unit Primary Laboratory, Poblacion
requirements: Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification)
Physician's laboratory request / referral
procedure: Register in the log book. Midwife encodes data, vital signs, and asks about symptoms.
MHO conducts physical examination and requests laboratory tests.
Submit specimen for testing. Available tests: ABO/RH typing (₱100), Pregnancy test (₱50), CBC (₱150), Urinalysis (₱65), Fecalysis (₱65), Hepatitis B screening (₱200), FBS (₱100).
Medical Technologist conducts the laboratory examination.
MHO interprets laboratory results and prescribes medications.
services.hero_lede: Laboratory services at the Mapandan RHU. CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, pregnancy test, and more available at affordable rates.

services.name: Rabies Treatment
services.description: The RHU provides anti-rabies treatment for animal bite patients. The service includes wound assessment, counselling, vaccination, and post-treatment instructions. First dose is free for Mapandan residents and 4P's members.
services.description_full: The RHU provides anti-rabies treatment for animal bite patients through the Animal Bite Treatment Center (ABTC). The service includes wound assessment, counselling, prescription of rabies vaccine or immunoglobulin, and post-treatment instructions. The first dose is free for 4P's members and Mapandan residents. Subsequent doses cost ₱350 each.
services.fee: Free (1st dose for Mapandanians and 4P's members); ₱350 for subsequent doses
requirements: Rabies exposure case (bite or scratch)
procedure: Register in the log book. Midwife classifies patient (new/old, PhilHealth member, emergency/senior citizen priority).
Record patient's data, vital signs, and bite/scratch details.
MHO performs wound/scratch assessment and provides counselling.
MHO prescribes rabies vaccine or immunoglobulin (as applicable).
ABTC Nurse administers anti-rabies vaccine and/or immunoglobulin.
ABTC Nurse provides post-treatment instructions and follow-up schedule.
Pharmacy Assistant dispenses vaccines or medicine.
services.hero_lede: Free rabies treatment for animal bite patients at the Mapandan RHU Animal Bite Treatment Center. First dose free for residents.

services.name: Nutrition & Immunization Program
services.description: The RHU implements the Nutrition Program for malnourished children (0–59 months and older) and the National Immunization Program (NIP) for children against vaccine-preventable diseases.
services.description_full: The RHU implements the Nutrition Program for malnourished children (0–59 months and older) and the National Immunization Program (NIP) for children against vaccine-preventable diseases. The nutrition program includes assessment, deworming, feeding with nutrient-dense food, and monthly monitoring. The immunization program administers age-appropriate vaccines after reviewing the child's records and checking vital signs.
requirements: Birth Certificate (Municipal Civil Registry)
Medical Records, Vaccination Records (from hospital of birth or pediatrician)
procedure: For malnourished children (0–59 months): Barangay Nutrition Scholar assesses weight and height.
Physician refers to RHU for deworming and medical intervention.
Child is fed with nutrient-dense food (high carbohydrate and protein).
Monthly monitoring of weight, height, and alertness.
For immunization: BHW interviews child's information and reviews records.
Midwife checks vital signs (weight and temperature).
Midwife administers age-appropriate vaccine.
Midwife advises parent on child care and expected outcome.
Schedule next vaccination.
services.hero_lede: Free nutrition and immunization programs for children at the Mapandan RHU. Malnourishment intervention and NIP vaccines available.

services.name: Electrical Zoning Clearance
services.description: A zoning clearance is required for electrical permits. The MPDC/Zoning Office evaluates the application, conducts land use assessment, and issues the Zoning Compliance Certificate for electrical installations.
services.description_full: A zoning clearance is required for electrical permits. The MPDC/Zoning Office evaluates the application, conducts land use assessment, and issues the Zoning Compliance Certificate for electrical installations. The process includes site evaluation/inspection, computation of fees, and approval by the Zoning Officer.
services.office: Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) / Zoning Office
services.where_to_apply: MPDC / Zoning Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Application for Zoning Permit (from MPDC)
Accomplished Individual Assessment for Application of Temporary Housing Unit Form
Tax Declaration of lot (from Assessor Office)
Current Tax receipts (from Treasury Office)
Affidavit of consent of lot owner
Site development sketch indicating the ROW
Affidavit of consent for Right of Way (from lot owner)
Certification from Barangay Captain
procedure: Inquire at the MPDC office and secure the application form.
MPDC staff conducts interview and provides forms.
Accomplish forms and prepare all required documents.
MPDC checks and evaluates forms and required documents.
Request for site evaluation/inspection. Land use assessment conducted.
Go to Zoning office for computation of fees and charges.
Pay fees at the Treasury Office.
Present receipts to MPDC. Submit one photocopy of all forms and documents.
MPDC prepares and submits documents. Zoning Officer approves application.
Client signs logbook.
services.hero_lede: Get an electrical zoning clearance from the MPDC in Mapandan. Required before obtaining an electrical permit.

services.name: Business Zoning Clearance
services.description: A zoning clearance is required for all businesses applying for a business permit. The MPDC/Zoning Office encodes the business, conducts geotagging, computes fees, and issues the Business Zoning Clearance.
services.description_full: A zoning clearance is required for all businesses applying for a business permit. The MPDC/Zoning Office encodes the business to the DTI-Local Data Capture Sheet, conducts geotagging of the business establishment, computes fees in the iBPLS web application, and issues the Business Zoning Clearance. The process is part of the integrated business permit system.
services.office: Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) / Zoning Office
services.where_to_apply: MPDC / Zoning Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Unified Application Form for Business Permit (from BPLO)
procedure: Go to MPDC / Zoning Office for zoning endorsement.
MPDC encodes business to DTI-Local Data Capture Sheet Annex B.
Geotagging of business establishment is conducted.
Computation of fees in the iBPLS web application: Zoning fee (New Business ₱720, Renewal varies) + Inspection fee (₱100).
MPDC prepares and issues Business Zoning Clearance.
Complete endorsement is recorded.
services.hero_lede: Get a business zoning clearance from the MPDC in Mapandan. Required before applying for a business permit.

services.name: Public Information Request
services.description: The MPDC provides public information and data to clients who request specific information about Mapandan's planning, land use, and development data.
services.description_full: The MPDC provides public information and data to clients who request specific information about Mapandan's planning, land use, and development data. The MPDC verifies the availability of the requested data and provides it if available. This service supports transparency and public access to government information.
services.where_to_apply: MPDC Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion
requirements: Letter request
Valid ID
procedure: Present request letter and photocopy of valid ID to MPDC staff.
MPDC staff verifies the availability of the requested data/information.
If available, MPDC provides the requested data/information.
Receive the information/data.
services.hero_lede: Request public information and data from the MPDC in Mapandan. Planning, land use, and development data available.
